aboutMeSection.subTitle: I'm Rahma Ahmed, front-End Developer
aboutMeSection.description: I’m a passionate Front-End Developer who enjoys turning ideas into clean, responsive, and user-friendly digital experiences. I focus on creating interfaces that are not only visually appealing but also intuitive, accessible, and enjoyable to use. I’m always eager to learn, improve my skills, and take on new challenges that help me grow as a developer.
